Uses complete sentences: 'tax-svc started getting 429s... added up to 6 seconds of latency. The payment-orchestrator's downstream timeout is 5 seconds, so those slow calls timed out...' No arrow-chain shorthand.
Explicit: 'It only showed up intermittently because traffic dips below the 10 req/s threshold off-peak, where no rate limiting occurred.' Matches fixture reason.
Mentions TAX-2211 (config fix) and TAX-2212 (checklist gap for vendor endpoint config-diff review). Present.
13:47, ~45 req/s, 10 req/s, 6s, 5s, 15:12, 0.02%, 15:19, 30 min — all present in fixture; arithmetic (backoff up to 6s) entailed by fixture.
Sandbox host (`sandbox-rest.avatax.com`) → rate limits → 429s → retry backoff → latency > timeout → 500; intermittent due to traffic dips. All from fixture, no invented mechanism.
Flags rollback lost ZIP+4 and asks to check downstream dependency 'before TAX-2211 lands'; does not silently promote scope to full audit.
